text: hey i know we can do it but there is no real capability to do so, but the @cart/plasma.tsx effect here, want to put inside of a lavalamp mesh, what should we do

events.text: Assessed: model paint today BAKES materials to atlas pixels (frozen frame); ground look proves live WGSL dispatch works per-frame. Recommending a live-material channel per face group in the model renderer, Zig-first.

resolution: Design question answered (no code): plasma-inside-a-lavalamp needs a LIVE material capability the model pipeline lacks — model paint bakes materials to static atlas pixels, so an animated shader freezes. Recommended the Zig-first path: a per-face-group live-material binding evaluated in the model's 3D fragment shader with a time uniform (same pattern the painted-ground look already uses via FILL_FUNCS composition), with Plasma joining the material catalog as a fill spec; lamp = glass shell via atlas alpha + inner blob mesh bound to the live material. Rejected the StaticSurface render-to-texture route as a React-side hack with the known freeze/tick problem.
